name: vittora
description: Vittora: practice stock trading platform (website, dashboard and API)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,desk,site --prefix-colors blue,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix dashboard run start:local" "npm --prefix frontend run start:local"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test -- --watchAll=false && npm --prefix dashboard test -- --watchAll=false

author: Priyanshu Jaiswal
